records.literal_gloss: Thus showed me [the] Lord Yahweh, and look, a basket of summer fruit.

en.L: Thus the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} showed me: look, a basket of summer fruit.
en.B: This is what the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} showed me: a basket of summer fruit.
en.R: The Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} showed me another vision. I saw a basket of ripe summer fruit.

es.L: Así me mostró el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: he aquí, una canasta de fruta de verano.
es.B: Esto es lo que me mostró el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: una canasta de fruta de verano.
es.R: El Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} me mostró otra visión. Vi una canasta de fruta madura de verano.

fr.L: Voici ce que me fit voir le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : voici, une corbeille de fruits d’été.
fr.B: Voici ce que le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} me fit voir : une corbeille de fruits d’été.
fr.R: Le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} m’a montré une autre vision. J’ai vu une corbeille de fruits d’été bien mûrs.

sw.L: Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} alinionyesha hivi: tazama, kikapu cha matunda ya kiangazi.
sw.B: Hiki ndicho Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} alichonionyesha: kikapu cha matunda ya kiangazi.
sw.R: Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} alinionyesha maono mengine. Niliona kikapu cha matunda ya kiangazi yaliyoiva.

vi.L: Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã cho tôi thấy thế này: kìa, một giỏ trái cây mùa hạ.
vi.B: Đây là điều Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho tôi thấy: một giỏ trái cây mùa hạ.
vi.R: Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho tôi thấy một khải tượng khác. Tôi thấy một giỏ trái cây chín của mùa hạ.

ko.L: 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 나에게 이와 같이 보여 주셨다. 보라, 여름 과일 한 바구니가 [있었다].
ko.B: 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 나에게 보여 주신 것은 이러하다. 여름 과일 한 바구니였다.
ko.R: 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 나에게 또 다른 환상을 보여 주셨다. 나는 잘 익은 여름 과일이 담긴 바구니를 보았다.

pt.L: Assim o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}} me mostrou: eis que [havia] um cesto de frutas de verão.
pt.B: Isto foi o que o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}} me mostrou: um cesto de frutas de verão.
pt.R: O Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}} me mostrou outra visão. Eu vi um cesto de frutas maduras de verão.

am.L: ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ አሳየኝ፤ እነሆ፣ የበጋ ፍሬ ቅርጫት [ነበረ]።
am.B: ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ያሳየኝ ይህ ነው፦ የበጋ ፍሬ የያዘ ቅርጫት።
am.R: ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሌላ ራእይ አሳየኝ። የበሰለ የበጋ ፍሬ የሞላበት ቅርጫት አየሁ።

hi.L: प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} ने मुझे यों दिखाया: देखो, गर्मी के फलों की एक टोकरी।
hi.B: प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} ने मुझे यह दिखाया: गर्मी के फलों की एक टोकरी।
hi.R: प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} ने मुझे एक और दर्शन दिखाया। मैंने गर्मी के पके फलों की एक टोकरी देखी।

ru.L: Так показал мне Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: вот, корзина спелых летних плодов.
ru.B: Вот что показал мне Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: корзину спелых летних плодов.
ru.R: Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} показал мне ещё одно видение. Я увидел корзину спелых летних плодов.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}はわたしにこのように示された。なんと、夏の果物のかごが一つあった。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}がわたしに示されたのは、一かごの夏の果物であった。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}は、わたしにまた別の幻を見せてくださいました。わたしは、熟した夏の果物が入ったかごを見ました。

uk.L: Так показав мені Владика {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: ось кошик літніх плодів.
uk.B: Ось що показав мені Владика {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: кошик літніх плодів.
uk.R: Владика {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} показав мені ще одне видіння. Я побачив кошик стиглих літніх плодів.

decisions.choice: the fourth vision
decisions.reason: The vision begins as the first three did (7:1, 4, 7) and, like the third, is told as a question and answer between the LORD and Amos (7:8). After the story of 7:10-17, the series of visions goes on.

decisions.choice: summer fruit: the ripe fruit of late summer, the last harvest of the year
decisions.reason: Qayits is the summer, and the fruit gathered at its end, such as figs (2 Samuel 16:1-2; Jeremiah 40:10). The harvest of summer fruit came at the end of the farming year.

decisions.choice: Thus the Lord GOD showed me: look (L); This is what the Lord GOD showed me (B); The Lord GOD showed me another vision (R)
decisions.reason: The opening formula keeps the wording of 7:1, 4 and 7 at each level. Readable adds 'ripe' to show what kind of fruit is meant (m2).

decisions.choice: "una canasta de fruta de verano" (L, B); "de fruta madura de verano" (R)
decisions.reason: As the terms note sets; the vision opening keeps the wording of 7:1.

decisions.choice: summer fruit "የበጋ ፍሬ", as 2 Samuel 16:1; the vision opens as 7:1
decisions.reason: The fruit of the last harvest keeps the word of 2 Samuel; the opening formula is the one set at 7:1.

decisions.choice: the opening of the visions as 7:1; गर्मी के फल
decisions.reason: The fourth vision (meaning decision m1) opens with the wording of 7:1, 4 and 7 at each level. Summer fruit is the ripe fruit of late summer (m2); Readable adds पके, as the English Readable adds "ripe". No deity_pronoun spans in this file, as through Amos.

decisions.choice: спелые летние плоды
decisions.reason: The ripe fruit of late summer, the last harvest of the year (meaning decision); "спелые" carries the sense of an end that the pun in verse 2 needs.

decisions.choice: kelub qayits "夏の果物のかご" (L), "一かごの夏の果物" (B), "熟した夏の果物が入ったかご" (R), the same words in 8:2.
decisions.reason: qayits is the ripe fruit of late summer, the last harvest (m2); 夏の果物 keeps the season, which carries the sense of an ending.

source.text: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר מָֽה־אַתָּ֤ה רֹאֶה֙ עָמ֔וֹס וָאֹמַ֖ר כְּל֣וּב קָ֑יִץ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י בָּ֤א הַקֵּץ֙ אֶל־עַמִּ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹא־אוֹסִ֥יף ע֖וֹד עֲב֥וֹר לֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said, What [are] you seeing, Amos? And I said, A basket of summer fruit. And Yahweh said to me, The end has come to my people Israel; I will not again pass by him anymore.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said, "What do you see, Amos?" And I said, "A basket of summer fruit." And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to me, "The end has come upon {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel; never again will I pass by them.
en.B: He asked, "What do you see, Amos?" I answered, "A basket of summer fruit." Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to me, "The end has come upon {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel. Never again will I pass them by.
en.R: He asked, "Amos, what do you see?" I answered, "A basket of summer fruit." Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to me, "The word for 'summer fruit' sounds like the word for 'end.' The end has come for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel. I will not let them go unpunished any longer.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} dijo: «¿Qué ves, Amós?». Y dije: «Una canasta de fruta de verano». Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dijo: «Ha llegado el fin sobre {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel; ya no volveré a pasarle por alto.
es.B: Él me preguntó: «¿Qué ves, Amós?». Respondí: «Una canasta de fruta de verano». Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dijo: «Ha llegado el fin para {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel. Ya no se lo dejaré pasar más.
es.R: Él me preguntó: «Amós, ¿qué ves?». Respondí: «Una canasta de fruta de verano». Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dijo: «En hebreo, la palabra “fruta de verano” suena como la palabra “fin”. Ha llegado el fin para {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel. Ya no dejaré más tiempo sin castigo a mi pueblo.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit : « Que vois-tu, Amos ? » Et je dis : « Une corbeille de fruits d’été. » Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} me dit : « La fin est venue pour {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël ; je ne passerai plus jamais à côté de lui.
fr.B: Il me demanda : « Que vois-tu, Amos ? » Je répondis : « Une corbeille de fruits d’été. » Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} me dit : « La fin est venue pour {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël. Je ne fermerai plus les yeux sur lui.
fr.R: Il m’a demandé : « Amos, que vois-tu ? » J’ai répondu : « Une corbeille de fruits d’été. » Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a dit : « Ces fruits sont mûrs, et le temps est mûr pour la fin de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël. Je ne le laisserai plus impuni.

sw.L: Naye akasema, "Unaona nini, Amosi?" Nikasema, "Kikapu cha matunda ya kiangazi." Naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akaniambia, "Mwisho umewajia watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli; sitapita kando yao tena kamwe.
sw.B: Akaniuliza, "Unaona nini, Amosi?" Nikajibu, "Kikapu cha matunda ya kiangazi." Ndipo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akaniambia, "Mwisho umewafikia watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli. Sitawapita tena bila kuwaadhibu.
sw.R: Akaniuliza, "Amosi, unaona nini?" Nikajibu, "Kikapu cha matunda ya kiangazi." Ndipo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akaniambia, "Kwa Kiebrania, neno la 'matunda ya kiangazi' linasikika kama neno la 'mwisho.' Mwisho umewafikia watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli. Sitawaacha tena bila kuwaadhibu.

vi.L: Ngài phán: "Ngươi thấy gì, A-mốt?" Tôi thưa: "Một giỏ trái cây mùa hạ." Và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với tôi: "Sự cuối cùng đã đến trên dân Y-sơ-ra-ên của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không bỏ qua cho chúng nữa.
vi.B: Ngài hỏi: "A-mốt, con thấy gì?" Tôi thưa: "Một giỏ trái cây mùa hạ." Bấy giờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với tôi: "Sự cuối cùng đã đến trên dân Y-sơ-ra-ên của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Ta sẽ không bỏ qua cho chúng nữa.
vi.R: Ngài hỏi: "A-mốt, con thấy gì?" Tôi thưa: "Một giỏ trái cây chín." Bấy giờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với tôi: "Trái cây đã chín, và dân Y-sơ-ra-ên của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng đã chín muồi cho ngày kết thúc. Trong tiếng Hê-bơ-rơ, chữ 'trái cây mùa hạ' nghe giống chữ 'sự cuối cùng.' Ta sẽ không để chúng thoát khỏi hình phạt nữa.

ko.L: 그분께서 말씀하셨다. "아모스야, 네가 무엇을 보느냐?" 내가 "여름 과일 한 바구니입니다" 하고 대답하자, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 말씀하셨다. "내 백성 이스라엘에게 끝이 왔다. 내가 다시는 그들을 그냥 지나치지 않겠다.
ko.B: 그분께서 물으셨다. "아모스야, 무엇이 보이느냐?" 내가 "여름 과일 한 바구니입니다" 하고 대답하자, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 말씀하셨다. "내 백성 이스라엘에게 끝이 왔다. 다시는 그들을 봐주지 않겠다.
ko.R: 그분께서 물으셨다. "아모스야, 무엇이 보이느냐?" 내가 "여름 과일 한 바구니입니다" 하고 대답했다. 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 말씀하셨다. "히브리 말로 '여름 과일'과 '끝'은 소리가 비슷하다. 내 백성 이스라엘에게 끝이 왔다. 다시는 그들이 벌을 받지 않고 넘어가게 두지 않겠다.

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} disse: "O que vês, Amós?" E eu disse: "Um cesto de frutas de verão." E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} me disse: "Chegou o fim sobre o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo Israel; nunca mais passarei por ele.
pt.B: Ele perguntou: "O que vês, Amós?" Respondi: "Um cesto de frutas de verão." Então {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} me disse: "Chegou o fim para o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo Israel. Não vou mais deixar passar.
pt.R: Ele perguntou: "Amós, o que estás vendo?" Respondi: "Um cesto de frutas de verão." Então {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} me disse: "Na língua hebraica, a palavra 'frutas de verão' soa como a palavra 'fim'. Chegou o fim para o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo Israel. Não vou mais deixar o povo sem castigo.

am.L: እርሱም፦ «አሞጽ ሆይ፣ ምን ታያለህ?» አለ። እኔም፦ «የበጋ ፍሬ ቅርጫት» አልኩ። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም እንዲህ አለኝ፦ «ፍጻሜው በሕዝቤ በእስራኤል ላይ መጥቷል፤ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ደግሜ አላልፋቸውም።
am.B: እርሱም፦ «አሞጽ ሆይ፣ ምን ታያለህ?» ብሎ ጠየቀኝ። እኔም፦ «የበጋ ፍሬ ቅርጫት» ብዬ መለስኩ። ከዚያም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ አለኝ፦ «መጨረሻው በሕዝቤ በእስራኤል ላይ ደርሷል። ከእንግዲህ በቸልታ አላልፋቸውም።
am.R: እርሱም፦ «አሞጽ ሆይ፣ ምን ታያለህ?» ብሎ ጠየቀኝ። እኔም፦ «የበጋ ፍሬ ቅርጫት» ብዬ መለስኩ። ከዚያም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ አለኝ፦ «በዕብራይስጥ “የበጋ ፍሬ” የሚለው ቃል “መጨረሻ” ከሚለው ቃል ጋር ይመሳሰላል። የሕዝቤ የእስራኤል መጨረሻ ደርሷል። ከእንግዲህ ሳልቀጣቸው አልተዋቸውም።

hi.L: और उन्होंने कहा, "हे आमोस, तुम क्या देखते हो?" और मैंने कहा, "गर्मी के फलों की एक टोकरी।" और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने मुझसे कहा, "मेरी प्रजा इस्राएल का अंत आ गया है; मैं फिर कभी उन्हें छोड़कर आगे न बढ़ूँगा।
hi.B: उन्होंने पूछा, "आमोस, तुम क्या देखते हो?" मैंने उत्तर दिया, "गर्मी के फलों की एक टोकरी।" तब {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने मुझसे कहा, "मेरी प्रजा इस्राएल का अंत आ पहुँचा है। अब मैं उन्हें और नहीं छोड़ूँगा।
hi.R: उन्होंने पूछा, "आमोस, तुम क्या देखते हो?" मैंने उत्तर दिया, "गर्मी के फलों की एक टोकरी।" तब {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने मुझसे कहा, "इब्रानी में 'गर्मी के फल' का शब्द 'अंत' के शब्द जैसा सुनाई देता है। मेरी प्रजा इस्राएल का अंत आ गया है। अब मैं उन्हें बिना दंड दिए और नहीं छोड़ूँगा।

ru.L: И {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} сказал: «Что ты видишь, Амос?» И я сказал: «Корзину спелых летних плодов.» И сказал мне {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: «Пришёл конец {{deity_pronoun:моему|Моему}} народу Израилю; не буду больше проходить мимо него.
ru.B: Он спросил: «Что ты видишь, Амос?» Я ответил: «Корзину спелых летних плодов.» Тогда {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сказал мне: «Пришёл конец {{deity_pronoun:моему|Моему}} народу Израилю. Больше {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не пройду мимо него.
ru.R: Он спросил: «Амос, что ты видишь?» Я ответил: «Корзину спелых летних плодов.» Тогда {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сказал мне: «На вашем языке слово “спелые плоды” звучит почти как слово “конец.” Пришёл конец {{deity_pronoun:моему|Моему}} народу Израилю. Я больше не оставлю его без наказания.

ja.L: その方は言われた。「アモスよ、あなたは何を見ているのか。」わたしは言った。「夏の果物のかごです。」{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はわたしに言われた。「わたしの民イスラエルに終わりが来た。わたしはもう二度と彼らを見過ごしにはしない。
ja.B: その方は尋ねられた。「アモスよ、何が見えるか。」わたしは答えた。「夏の果物のかごです。」すると{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はわたしに言われた。「わたしの民イスラエルに終わりが来た。もう二度と彼らを見逃さない。
ja.R: その方は尋ねられました。「アモスよ、何が見えるか。」わたしは答えました。「夏の果物のかごです。」すると{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はわたしに言われました。「『夏の果物』という言葉は、『終わり』という言葉と響きが似ている。わたしの民イスラエルに終わりが来た。もう、彼らを罰せずにおくことはしない。

uk.L: І {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} сказав: «Що ти бачиш, Амосе?» А я сказав: «Кошик літніх плодів.» І {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} сказав мені: «Прийшов кінець {{deity_pronoun:моєму|Моєму}} народові Ізраїлю; більше {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не пройду повз нього.
uk.B: Він запитав: «Що ти бачиш, Амосе?» Я відповів: «Кошик літніх плодів.» Тоді {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} сказав мені: «Прийшов кінець {{deity_pronoun:моєму|Моєму}} народові Ізраїлю. Я більше не пропускатиму їм.
uk.R: Він запитав: «Амосе, що ти бачиш?» Я відповів: «Кошик літніх плодів.» Тоді {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} сказав мені: «Слово, що означає “літні плоди”, звучить, як слово, що означає “кінець”. Прийшов кінець {{deity_pronoun:моєму|Моєму}} народові Ізраїлю. Я більше не залишу їх без кари.

decisions.choice: summer fruit (qayits) and end (qets): a play on words
decisions.reason: The two words sound almost the same in Hebrew: qayits, 'summer fruit', and qets, 'end'. The basket of ripe fruit at the end of the harvest becomes a sign that Israel is ripe for judgment and its end has come. Jeremiah's vision of the almond tree works the same way (Jeremiah 1:11-12).

decisions.choice: I will not pass by them again: as 7:8
decisions.reason: The line repeats 7:8: the LORD will no longer spare them. Here it is joined to the announcement that the end has come.

decisions.choice: the pun: stated in the text (R), footnoted (L, B)
decisions.reason: As in Jeremiah 1:12, Readable says in the text that the two words sound alike, since without it the LORD's answer makes no sense to a reader. Literal and Balanced keep the words of the Hebrew, and a footnote gives the pun (m1). The rest of the verse repeats the wording of 7:8 at each level.

decisions.choice: "En hebreo, la palabra “fruta de verano” suena como la palabra “fin”" (R)
decisions.reason: The pun qayits / qets is said in the text at R, as the terms note sets after Jeremiah 1:12 R; L and B leave it to the meaning footnote. The words explained take “ ” inside the « » of the speech.

decisions.choice: the wording of 7:8 for "pass by"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew repeats 7:8, and the Spanish repeats its own wording there at each level.

decisions.choice: "fruits d'été ... la fin" (L, B, with the English footnote); "Ces fruits sont mûrs, et le temps est mûr pour la fin" (R)
alternatives: R as the English: "le mot 'fruits d'été' ressemble au mot 'fin'"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew plays on qayits and qets. French cannot keep the sounds, so Readable makes its own play on "mûr", which the term sheet allows, and says the meaning in the text, as the English Readable does in its own way.

decisions.choice: "matunda ya kiangazi" / "mwisho"; Readable states the pun ("Kwa Kiebrania ...")
decisions.reason: Swahili cannot reproduce the pun on qayits and qets, so Readable explains it in the text, as Jeremiah 1:12 R does; Literal and Balanced leave it to the footnote.

decisions.choice: "여름 과일 … 끝" (L, B, with the footnote on the pun); R says the pun in the text: "히브리 말로 '여름 과일'과 '끝'은 소리가 비슷하다"
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording: *qayits* and *qets* sound alike in Hebrew but not in Korean, so Readable explains it as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "trái cây mùa hạ ... sự cuối cùng" (L, B); "chín ... chín muồi cho ngày kết thúc" (R)
decisions.reason: Qayits (summer fruit) and qets (end) are a pun that Vietnamese cannot copy. Literal and Balanced translate the words and leave the pun to the meaning decision's footnote; Readable keeps a pun of its own with "chín" (ripe) and "chín muồi" (ripe for), as the terms sheet proposes, and also states the Hebrew pun, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: frutas de verão ... o fim; the pun explained in the text (R)
decisions.reason: The play on qayits, "summer fruit", and qets, "end" (m1), has no Portuguese equivalent in sound. A pun of sense ("frutas maduras", Israel "maduro" for the end) would add a picture the Hebrew does not have, so Literal and Balanced keep the words of the Hebrew and leave the pun to the meaning note, and Readable says in the text that the two words sound alike, as the English Readable does. The rest of the exchange keeps 7:8's Portuguese.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in Amharic
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the English spans on the LORD's pronouns in this chapter have no Amharic counterpart.

decisions.choice: the pun on summer fruit (qayits) and end (qets) is footnoted at Literal and Balanced; Readable states it, adding "በዕብራይስጥ" (in Hebrew)
decisions.reason: "የበጋ ፍሬ" and "ፍጻሜ" ("መጨረሻ") do not sound alike in Amharic, so the vision turns on a Hebrew word play the reader cannot hear: the summer fruit (qayits) shows that the end (qets) has come. Readable says that the likeness is in the Hebrew words, so it does not seem to claim it for Amharic.

decisions.choice: the pun on qayits (summer fruit) and qets (end): footnoted (L, B), stated in the text (R)
decisions.reason: The vision turns on a play on words that Hindi cannot copy (meaning decision m1). Literal and Balanced translate the words and leave the pun to a footnote; Readable says in the text that in Hebrew the two words sound alike, as the English Readable does. "I will not pass by them" keeps the wording of 7:8 (m2).

decisions.choice: the pun on qayits (summer fruit) and qets (end): footnoted (L, B), stated in the text (R)
decisions.reason: Russian cannot reproduce the play on words (meaning decision); as the English, Readable says it in the text and Literal and Balanced leave it to the footnote.

decisions.choice: the wording of 7:8 for "I will not pass by them again"
decisions.reason: The same words as 7:8 (meaning decision), so each level repeats its Russian.

decisions.choice: The pun qayits / qets is footnoted at L and B ("夏の果物" / "終わり" with no wordplay in Japanese) and stated in the text at R ("『夏の果物』という言葉は、『終わり』という言葉と響きが似ている"), as the English per level; the closing line as 7:8.
alternatives: a Japanese pun such as "実り" / "終わり"
decisions.reason: Japanese has no pair that keeps both meanings without changing what Amos saw; the English does the same per level (r-en-1).

decisions.choice: «Слово, що означає “літні плоди”, звучить, як слово, що означає “кінець”» at R, as the English Readable states the pun
alternatives: a footnote only, as at L and B
decisions.reason: The two Ukrainian words do not sound alike, so the sentence says that the words for them do, as the English Readable does; L and B keep the plain wording and leave the pun to the footnote.

records.literal_gloss: And will wail [the] songs of [the] temple in that day, declares [the] Lord Yahweh; many the corpses; in every place he has thrown [them]. Hush!

en.L: And the songs of the temple will become wailing in that day, declares the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}. Many [will be] the corpses; in every place they will be thrown out. Hush!"
en.B: On that day the songs of the temple will turn to wailing, declares the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}. There will be many dead bodies, thrown out everywhere. Hush!"
en.R: At that time the songs in the temple will turn into loud crying, says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}. There will be dead bodies everywhere, thrown out in every place. Be quiet!"

es.L: Y los cantos del templo se volverán gemidos en aquel día, declara el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}. Muchos [serán] los cadáveres; en todo lugar serán arrojados. ¡Silencio!».
es.B: Aquel día los cantos del templo se convertirán en gemidos, afirma el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}. Habrá muchos cadáveres, tirados por todas partes. ¡Silencio!».
es.R: Ese día los cantos del templo se convertirán en gritos de dolor, dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}. Habrá cadáveres por todas partes, tirados en cualquier lugar. ¡Silencio!».

fr.L: Et les chants du temple deviendront des hurlements en ce jour-là, déclare le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}. Nombreux [seront] les cadavres ; en tout lieu on les jettera. Silence ! »
fr.B: Ce jour-là, les chants du temple se changeront en hurlements, déclare le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}. Il y aura beaucoup de cadavres, jetés partout. Silence ! »
fr.R: En ce temps-là, les chants du temple se changeront en cris de douleur, dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}. Il y aura des cadavres partout, jetés n’importe où. Taisez-vous ! »

sw.L: Na nyimbo za hekalu zitakuwa maombolezo katika siku ile, asema Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}. Maiti [zitakuwa] nyingi; mahali pote zitatupwa nje. Kimya!"
sw.B: Siku hiyo nyimbo za hekalu zitageuka kuwa maombolezo, asema Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}. Kutakuwa na maiti nyingi, zimetupwa kila mahali. Kimya!"
sw.R: Wakati huo nyimbo za hekaluni zitageuka kuwa vilio vikubwa, anasema Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}. Kutakuwa na maiti kila mahali, zimetupwa nje kila mahali. Nyamazeni!"

vi.L: Và các bài ca trong đền thờ sẽ thành tiếng gào khóc trong ngày ấy, Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy. Xác chết [sẽ] nhiều lắm; người ta sẽ quăng ra khắp mọi nơi. Im đi!"
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy, các bài ca trong đền thờ sẽ biến thành tiếng gào khóc, Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy. Xác chết sẽ nhiều vô kể, bị quăng ra khắp nơi. Im đi!"
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy, các bài hát trong đền thờ sẽ biến thành tiếng khóc lóc thảm thiết, Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. Xác chết sẽ ở khắp nơi, bị quăng ra mọi chỗ. Hãy im lặng!"

ko.L: 그날에 성전의 노래들이 통곡이 될 것이다. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 선언이다. 시체가 많을 것이다. 곳곳에 그것들을 내던질 것이다. 쉿!"
ko.B: 그날에는 성전의 노래가 통곡으로 바뀔 것이다. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 말이다. 시체가 많아서 곳곳에 내던져져 있을 것이다. 쉿!"
ko.R: 그때에는 성전에서 부르던 노래가 큰 울음소리로 바뀔 것이다. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 말이다. 어디에나 시체가 널려 있을 것이다. 조용히 하여라!"

pt.L: E os cânticos do templo se tornarão uivos naquele dia, declara o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}. Muitos [serão] os cadáveres; em todo lugar serão lançados fora. Silêncio!"
pt.B: Naquele dia os cânticos do templo se transformarão em uivos, declara o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}. Haverá muitos cadáveres, jogados por toda parte. Silêncio!"
pt.R: Naquele dia os cânticos no templo vão virar gritos de choro, diz o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}. Vai haver cadáveres por toda parte, jogados em todo lugar. Fiquem quietos!"

am.L: በዚያ ቀን የመቅደሱ መዝሙሮች ዋይታ ይሆናሉ፣ ይላል ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}። ሬሳው ብዙ [ይሆናል]፤ በስፍራው ሁሉ ይጣላል። ዝም በሉ!»
am.B: በዚያ ቀን የቤተ መቅደሱ መዝሙሮች ወደ ዋይታ ይለወጣሉ፣ ይላል ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}። ብዙ ሬሳ ይሆናል፤ በየስፍራው ይጣላል። ዝም በሉ!»
am.R: በዚያ ቀን በቤተ መቅደሱ የሚዘመሩት መዝሙሮች ወደ ታላቅ ልቅሶ ይለወጣሉ፣ ይላል ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}። በየቦታው የሞቱ ሰዎች ሬሳ ተጥሎ ይገኛል። ዝም በሉ!»

hi.L: और उस दिन मन्दिर के गीत विलाप बन जाएँगे, प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है। लाशें बहुत [होंगी]; हर स्थान पर वे फेंक दी जाएँगी। चुप!"
hi.B: उस दिन मन्दिर के गीत विलाप में बदल जाएँगे, प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है। बहुत-सी लाशें होंगी, जो हर जगह फेंकी पड़ी होंगी। चुप!"
hi.R: उस दिन मन्दिर के गीत ज़ोर-ज़ोर से रोने में बदल जाएँगे, प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} कहते हैं। हर जगह लाशें होंगी, जो हर स्थान पर फेंकी पड़ी होंगी। चुप रहो!"

ru.L: И станут песни храма воплями в тот день, — слово Владыки {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}. Много трупов; во всяком месте их выбросят. Тише!»
ru.B: В тот день песни храма превратятся в вопли, — говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. Будет много мёртвых тел, выброшенных повсюду. Тише!»
ru.R: В тот день песни в храме превратятся в громкий плач, — говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. Повсюду будут мёртвые тела, выброшенные где попало. Молчите!»

ja.L: その日には、神殿の歌は泣きわめく声となる。――{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}の言葉――しかばねは多く、至る所に投げ捨てられる。黙れ。」
ja.B: その日、神殿の歌は泣き叫ぶ声に変わる、と{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}は告げる。多くのしかばねが、至る所に投げ捨てられる。静かに！」
ja.R: そのとき、神殿の歌は大きな泣き声に変わる、と{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}は言う。至る所に死体が投げ捨てられる。静かに！」

uk.L: І пісні храму стануть голосінням того дня, говорить Владика {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}. Багато [буде] трупів; у кожному місці їх викинуть. Тихо!»
uk.B: Того дня пісні храму обернуться на голосіння, говорить Владика {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}. Буде багато мертвих тіл, викинутих усюди. Тихо!»
uk.R: Того часу пісні в храмі обернуться на гучний плач, каже Владика {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}. Усюди будуть мертві тіла, викинуті в кожному місці. Мовчіть!»

decisions.choice: the songs of the temple will become wailing: the singing in the temple will turn to howls of grief
alternatives: the singing women of the palace will wail (with different vowels)
decisions.reason: Hekhal is both a palace and a temple. With the vowels of the Hebrew text, 'the songs of the temple will wail' means that the joyful singing of worship will turn into cries of grief (compare verse 10). With different vowels, shirot can be 'singing women', and the line would say that the women singers of the palace will wail. The point is the same: joy will turn to mourning.

decisions.choice: many corpses ... thrown out: the dead lie everywhere, unburied
decisions.reason: The short, broken phrases give the scene of a city after slaughter: the bodies are many, they are thrown out anywhere, and the survivors say only 'Hush!' (as 6:10). The verb 'has thrown' has no subject: the bodies are simply cast out.

decisions.choice: in that day (L); on that day (B); at that time (R); declares \q says the Lord GOD
decisions.reason: Bayyom hahu and ne'um Adonai YHWH follow the wording settled in Isaiah and Ezekiel at each level. 'Hush' is 'Be quiet' at Readable, as 6:10.

decisions.choice: naquele dia (R)
decisions.reason: "Naquele dia" stays at every level, as set at 2:16, where the English Readable says "at that time"; Portuguese keeps the phrase that ties the day to the day of the LORD.

decisions.choice: the temple (heikhal) "መቅደሱ" (L), "ቤተ መቅደሱ" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The wording settled for heikhal in Kings at Literal; Balanced and Readable use the everyday word for the temple.

decisions.choice: उस दिन; प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है (L, B), कहते हैं (R); चुप
decisions.reason: "In that day" and the formula keep their settled wording; "Hush!" is चुप as in 6:10, चुप रहो at Readable.

decisions.choice: Hear this: the oracles in poetry resume
decisions.reason: After the vision of verses 1-3, told in prose, Amos speaks in poetry again, as in 3:1, 4:1 and 5:1. The charge against the merchants (verses 4-6) explains why the end has come.

decisions.choice: trample: crush, or pant after
decisions.reason: Sha'af means to pant after something or to trample it. In 2:7 the rich 'trample the head of the poor into the dust of the earth'. Either way they treat the needy as prey.

decisions.choice: the poor of the land: the written text has 'the humble', and the reading in the margin 'the poor'
decisions.reason: The written Hebrew has 'anwe, 'the humble', and the traditional reading noted in the margin is 'aniyye, 'the poor' or 'afflicted'. The two words are close in form and sense, and the translation follows the reading.

decisions.choice: put an end to the poor: their greed would wipe the poor out of the land
decisions.reason: Lashbit, 'to make cease', may be a play on shabbat, the sabbath of verse 5: those who cannot wait for the sabbath to cease would make the poor cease.

decisions.choice: 'aniyyei / 'anwei 'arets "地の苦しむ者たち" (L, B), "国の貧しい人々" (R); 'evyon "貧しい者" as 2:6.
alternatives: "地のへりくだる者たち" (the written text, m3)
decisions.reason: The English follows the margin reading "the poor" (m3); 苦しむ者 is the afflicted poor, kept apart from 'evyon 貧しい者 and dal 弱い者.

records.literal_gloss: saying, When will pass the new moon, so that we may sell grain, and the sabbath, so that we may open [the] grain, to make small [the] ephah and to make great [the] shekel, and to falsify balances of deceit,

en.L: saying, "When will the new moon be over, so that we may sell grain, \q and the sabbath, so that we may offer wheat [for sale], \q making the ephah small and the shekel great, \q and falsifying deceitful scales,
en.B: who say, "When will the new moon festival be over, so that we can sell grain? \q When will the sabbath end, so that we can put out wheat for sale, \q making the ephah smaller and the shekel heavier, \q and cheating with dishonest scales,
en.R: You say, "When will the new moon festival be over, so that we can sell grain? \q When will the sabbath be over, so that we can sell wheat again? \q Then we can give people less grain and make them pay more silver. \q We can cheat them with dishonest scales.

es.L: que {{plural_you:dicen|decís}}: «¿Cuándo pasará la luna nueva, para que vendamos grano, \q y el sábado, para que ofrezcamos el trigo? \q [Así] achicaremos el efa y agrandaremos el siclo, \q y falsearemos las balanzas engañosas,
es.B: que {{plural_you:dicen|decís}}: «¿Cuándo terminará la fiesta de la luna nueva, para que podamos vender grano? \q ¿Cuándo acabará el sábado, para que podamos poner a la venta el trigo? \q Así achicaremos el efa y aumentaremos el siclo, \q y engañaremos con balanzas falsas,
es.R: {{plural_you:Ustedes dicen|Vosotros decís}}: «¿Cuándo terminará la fiesta de la luna nueva, para que podamos vender grano? \q ¿Cuándo acabará el sábado, para que podamos volver a vender trigo? \q Entonces podremos dar menos grano y cobrar más plata. \q Podremos engañar a la gente con balanzas falsas.

fr.L: vous qui dites : « Quand la nouvelle lune sera-t-elle passée, pour que nous vendions le grain, \q et le sabbat, pour que nous ouvrions [les sacs de] blé, \q en rendant l’épha petit et le sicle grand, \q et en faussant des balances trompeuses,
fr.B: vous qui dites : « Quand la fête de la nouvelle lune sera-t-elle finie, pour que nous puissions vendre le grain ? \q Quand le sabbat sera-t-il terminé, pour que nous mettions le blé en vente, \q en diminuant l’épha et en alourdissant le sicle, \q et en trichant avec des balances fausses,
fr.R: Vous dites : « Quand la fête de la nouvelle lune sera-t-elle finie, pour que nous puissions vendre notre grain ? \q Quand le sabbat sera-t-il fini, pour que nous puissions de nouveau vendre du blé ? \q Alors nous donnerons moins de grain aux gens et nous leur ferons payer plus d’argent. \q Nous les tromperons avec des balances fausses.

vi.L: các ngươi nói: "Bao giờ ngày trăng mới qua đi, để chúng ta bán lúa, \q và ngày Sa-bát, để chúng ta bày lúa mì [ra bán], \q làm ê-pha nhỏ lại và siếc-lơ lớn lên, \q và gian lận bằng cân giả dối,

am.L: እንዲህ የምትሉ፦ «የወር መባቻ መቼ ያልፋል፣ እህል እንድንሸጥ? \q ሰንበትስ [መቼ ያልፋል]፣ ስንዴ [ለሽያጭ] እንድናወጣ? \q ኢፍን እያሳነስን ሰቅልንም እያከበድን፣ \q የሐሰት ሚዛንንም እያጣመምን፣

am.R: እንዲህ ትላላችሁ፦ «እህል እንድንሸጥ የወር መባቻው በዓል መቼ ያልፋል? \q ስንዴ እንደ ገና እንድንሸጥ ሰንበት መቼ ያልፋል? \q ያን ጊዜ ለሰዎች ያነሰ እህል ሰጥተን ብዙ ብር እናስከፍላቸዋለን። \q በተጭበረበረ ሚዛንም እናታልላቸዋለን።

decisions.choice: the new moon and the sabbath: holy days on which trade stopped
decisions.reason: The first day of each month (the new moon) and the seventh day of each week were holy days, and work and trade stopped (Numbers 28:9-15; Nehemiah 10:32; 13:15-22). The merchants keep the days, but only in form: they cannot wait for them to be over.

decisions.choice: making the ephah small and the shekel great: cheating on both the measure and the price
decisions.reason: The ephah was the measure in which grain was sold; the shekel was the weight against which the buyer's silver was weighed, before coins were in use. A smaller ephah gives the buyer less grain; a heavier shekel weight makes him pay more silver. Dishonest scales do both. The law demands honest weights and measures (Leviticus 19:35-36; Deuteronomy 25:13-15).

decisions.choice: ephah and shekel kept (L, B); give people less grain and make them pay more silver (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the names of the measure and the weight, and the note says what they were (m2). Readable says what the cheating did. No units setting is used, since the words name the tools of measuring, not an amount. Balanced and Readable add 'festival' to 'new moon'.
